quote: Oceaneering International, Inc. (“Oceaneering”) (NYSE:OII) announced that its Brazilian subsidiary, Marine Production Systems do Brasil LTDA (“MPS”), was awarded multiple Subsea Robotics contracts by Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. (“Petrobras”) during the second quarter of 2025, following a competitive tender. The anticipated aggregate revenue of the contracts is approximately $180 million.
note: Opened Oceaneering investor English primary 28 Aug 2025.
